title: Wall Crawlers
description: A new Type of Zombies will Crawl your Walls with Ladders!!
body:
# Wall Crawlers

Walls used to be enough. Not anymore.

Wall Crawlers adds the **Climber** — an undead woodworker that doesn't stop at the bottom of your
wall. When it can't walk to you, it **builds a ladder and climbs**. Box yourself in, wall off your
base, dig into a hillside — if there's a wall between you and the Climber, it'll scale it and drop
in after you.

## How it works

- **The Climber** is a zombie-like mob (it chases, burns in daylight, the usual) with one extra
  trick: when its path to you is blocked by a wall, it lays down **temporary ladders** and rides
  them up and over.
- **It actually reaches you.** It will climb the wall around your base or scale the lip of the cave
  you're hiding in. Simple walls no longer keep it out.
- **The ladders rot away.** Every ladder it places removes itself after a few minutes, so your base
  never ends up permanently scaffolded — the siege cleans up after itself.
- **Light on performance.** No constant world scans and no per-ladder ticking entities — the climb
  logic only runs when a Climber is genuinely stuck against a wall, so it won't drag your game down.

## Getting one

Climbers spawn naturally at night across the overworld.
Grab a **Climber Spawn Egg** from the Spawn Eggs tab to try it out.
